     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange

     8	/-!
     9	# The overlap component of finite-stage Picard base change
    10	
    11	The overlaps produced by `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` are nested pullbacks. We first
    12	flatten that categorical presentation, using the certified pullback presentation of
    13	the original overlap, and then apply the existing affine overlap comparison.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-- Flatten the nested pullback obtained by first base-changing `U` and then
    28	intersecting it with `V`. The only input about `W` is its displayed pullback
    29	presentation as `U ×_X V`. -/
    30	noncomputable def nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
    31	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    32	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    33	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    34	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    35	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    36	    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
    37	      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g := by
    38	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    39	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    40	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    41	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    42	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    43	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    44	  exact
    45	    asIso (pullback.map
    46	      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
    47	      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
    48	      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
    49	      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    50	    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    51	    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    52	    asIso (pullback.map
    53	      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
    54	      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g
    55	      e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
    56	      (by
    57	        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
    58	          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) e_inv_fst.symm)
    59	      (by simp))
    60	
    61	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    62	/-- The first projection of the flattened pullback recovers the first projection
    63	of the inner pullback after composing with the first leg of the displayed overlap. -/
    64	@[reassoc]
    65	theorem nestedPullbackFlatteningIso_hom_comp_fst_comp_a
    66	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    67	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    68	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    69	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    70	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    71	    (nestedPullbackFlatteningIso iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫
    72	        pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ a =
    73	      pullback.fst (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≫
    74	        pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g := by
    75	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    76	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    77	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    78	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    79	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    80	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    81	  simp only [nestedPullbackFlatteningIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    82	    pullback.map, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc,
    83	    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc]
    84	  rw [e_inv_fst]
    85	  simp
    86	
    87	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    88	/-- The first projection of the flattened pullback recovers the outer second
    89	projection after composing with the second leg of the displayed overlap. -/
    90	@[reassoc]
    91	theorem nestedPullbackFlatteningIso_hom_comp_fst_comp_b
    92	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    93	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    94	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    95	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    96	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    97	    (nestedPullbackFlatteningIso iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫
    98	        pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ b =
    99	      pullback.snd (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV := by
   100	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
   101	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
   102	  have e_inv_snd : e.inv ≫ b = pullback.snd iU iV := by
   103	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).snd = _
   104	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
   105	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.right
   106	  simp only [nestedPullbackFlatteningIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
   107	    pullback.map, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc,
   108	    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc]
   109	  rw [e_inv_snd]
   110	  simp
   111	
   112	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   113	/-- The second projection of the flattened pullback is the second projection of
   114	the inner pullback after the outer first projection. -/
   115	@[reassoc]
   116	theorem nestedPullbackFlatteningIso_hom_comp_snd
   117	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
   118	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
   119	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
   120	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
   121	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
   122	    (nestedPullbackFlatteningIso iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫
   123	        pullback.snd (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g =
   124	      pullback.fst (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≫
   125	        pullback.snd (iU ≫ f) g := by
   126	  simp [nestedPullbackFlatteningIso, pullback.map, Category.assoc]
   127	
   128	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   129	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   130	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
   131	
   132	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
   133	
   134	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   135	-- Projecting the package unfolds the dependent finite-subextension towers.
   136	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
   137	/-- Flatten the overlap in the base-changed gluing to the pullback of the
   138	original overlap structure map. -/
   139	noncomputable def gluingOverlapFlatteningIso
   140	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   141	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   142	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   143	    (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   144	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).V (U, V) ≅
   145	    pullback
   146	      (P.glueData.f U V ≫ P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap)
   147	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) := by
   148	  let g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of P.N.1) :=
   149	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))
   150	  exact nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
   151	    (P.glueData.ι U) (P.glueData.ι V) P.gluedMap g
   152	    (P.glueData.f U V)
   153	    (P.glueData.t U V ≫ P.glueData.f V U)
   154	    (by
   155	      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
   156	        (P.glueData.glue_condition U V).symm)
   157	    (P.glueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit U V)
   158	
   159	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
   160	
   161	end
   162	
   163	end AlgebraicGeometry

    38	restriction is the exact left restriction of the separably closed atlas. -/

    51	    P.N.1 k
